'''Pulse mass generator tubes''' were [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-mounted weaponry developed by the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]]. They were used to deploy [[pulse mass mine]]s.<ref name="EGVV" /> Each [[Hapan Battle Dragon]] was equipped with four tubes, each carrying a magazine of four mines.<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
